title: Austrian Foreign Ministry reports unauthorised access to a supplier-run website, staff contact data viewed
date_note: Access on 12 to 13 November, noticed 13 November; the ministry announced it on 20 November.
summary: Austria's Foreign Ministry said in a press release, relayed by ORF, that there was unauthorised access to a website run by an external service provider between 12 and 13 November, noticed on 13 November and stopped immediately. The ministry said only names and work contact details of staff at headquarters and missions abroad were viewed and no citizens' personal data was affected. The ministry said the access coincided with a worldwide Microsoft outage.
plain: Austria's Foreign Ministry says someone gained unauthorised access to a supplier-run website and saw staff names and work contact details, but no citizen data, per its statement.
exec: A government ministry's supplier-run website was accessed without authorisation; the ministry says only staff contact data was viewed.
org: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs

sources.name: ORF.at (20 November 2026, citing the ministry press release)

validation.note: ORF.at and the EFE wire (read on Latinus and ABC Color) each report the ministry's statement: access 12-13 November, noticed 13 November, staff names and work contact details, no citizens' data. The ministry's own release was not read.

review.note: Compared title, summary, 12-13 Nov access, noticed 13 Nov, staff names/work contacts, no citizen data, Microsoft outage coincidence against ORF and EFE copies (ABC Color, Latinus); ministry statement quoted, status confirmed, corroborated by ORF plus EFE
